title: Bank Deposit Fee Schedule
content:
Bank Deposit transfer fees are set per tier by principal band. Each band is inclusive at both ends, and the bands of a tier cover its whole principal range. Funding and SWIFT charges sit beside the transfer fee. All figures are in US dollars unless shown as a percentage.

## Transfer fee by principal band

| Tier | Band (principal, USD) | Transfer fee |
|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 10.00 to 999.99 | 1.99 |
| | 1000.00 to 2999.99 | 2.99 |
| | 3000.00 to 10000.00 | 3.99 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 10.00 to 999.99 | 2.99 |
| | 1000.00 to 2999.99 | 3.99 |
| | 3000.00 to 10000.00 | 4.99 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 10.00 to 499.99 | 3.99 |
| | 500.00 to 999.99 | 4.99 |
| | 1000.00 to 2999.00 | 5.99 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 50.00 to 999.99 | 3.49 |
| | 1000.00 to 2999.99 | 4.49 |
| | 3000.00 to 6000.00 | 5.49 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 5000.00 to 24999.99 | 9.99 |
| | 25000.00 to 75000.00 | 14.99 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 100.00 to 50000.00 | 24.99 |

## Funding and SWIFT charges

| Tier | Credit card funding fee (percent of principal) | Debit card fee | Pay-by-bank discount off the band fee | SWIFT charge options | OUR surcharge | Intermediary deduction estimate (SHA) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 | not applicable | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 3.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 | not applicable | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 3.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 | not applicable | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | SHA, OUR | 20.00 | 15.00 |

## Definitions

- **Credit card funding fee.** A percentage of principal charged when the transfer is funded by credit card; it is 0 on a tier that does not accept credit cards.
- **Debit card fee.** A flat amount added when the transfer is funded by debit card.
- **Pay-by-bank discount.** An amount taken off the band fee when the transfer is funded by pay-by-bank; the fee never goes below 0.00.
- **OUR surcharge.** The fee for the OUR option on SWIFT payments, under which Paloma pays every intermediary bank charge.
- **Intermediary deduction estimate.** The intermediary-bank deduction disclosed as an estimate on SHA payments.

## Band checks (hypothetical principals)

| Tier | Principal | Band reached | Transfer fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Standard | 999.99 | first band | 2.99 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 1000.00 | second band | 3.99 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 499.99 | first band | 3.99 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 500.00 | second band | 4.99 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 25000.00 | second band | 14.99 |

On Bank Deposit Express Plus, a pay-by-bank transfer of 1500.00 sits in the 4.49 band, and the 1.00 pay-by-bank discount brings that band fee to 3.49 (hypothetical example).
